```plato

    //==
    // # ClassicEasing — the classic catalog as a curve
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inbetweening
    // ClassicEasing is a selector, not a record, so its curve is written here.
    // Linear is the identity; every other selection is one family's ease-in
    // shape placed by its phase — Out is the reversed shape 1 - f(1 - t), and
    // InOut runs the In shape over the first half and the reversed one over the
    // second. Only the ten In shapes are spelled out; the phases are derived.

    // The decelerating bounce: four parabolic arcs of decreasing height over the
    // unit interval. The Bounce family is conventionally defined by this
    // out-phase shape, so the In shape below is its reversal rather than the
    // other way round.
    BounceOut(t: Number): Number {
        var amplitude = 7.5625;
        var period = 2.75;
        return t < 1.0 / period
                 ? amplitude * t * t
             : t < 2.0 / period
                 ? amplitude * (t - 1.5 / period) * (t - 1.5 / period) + 0.75
             : t < 2.5 / period
                 ? amplitude * (t - 2.25 / period) * (t - 2.25 / period) + 0.9375
             : amplitude * (t - 2.625 / period) * (t - 2.625 / period) + 0.984375;
    }
```
